title: A Package at the Post Office
transcript:
Woman: Hey, are you heading out? Could you pick up a package for me at the post office?
Man: Sure. Do I need anything to get it?
Woman: The slip's on the fridge. They usually want the recipient's ID, but I signed the back, so you should be fine.
Man: Okay, I'll grab it. Anything else while I'm out?
Woman: We're out of dish soap. I keep forgetting to buy it.
Man: Me too. Post office, then the store. I'll be back in an hour or so.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do first?
options: Mail a letter to her family
Bring her ID to the post office
questions.explanation: She asks him to pick up a package for her at the post office.

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention that she signed the slip?
options: To show that she already paid the delivery fee
To explain why the package was delayed
To assure the man he can pick up the package for her
To remind the man to sign it as well
questions.explanation: Normally the recipient's ID is needed, but her signature lets someone else collect it, so the man should be fine.
